Changelog

What changed.

Every release, with the fixes that went into it. The app’s own change log on GitHub has 150 fixes in it, and the ones that mattered most are here.

  1. v0.34.0BledLatest16 Oct 20268 fixes

    Animate gets a timeline along the bottom and a motion for pistons. Claude can read and write notes. The axis tools of Cinema 4D arrive, a selected group shows its parts softly, and the Windows download can carry Python inside.

    • NewA timeline along the bottom. Animate is a drawer set out like a video editor: a ruler, a row for every animated object and a bar for every motion. Drag the ruler or the playhead to scrub; drag the end of a bar to change its repeats and the bar to change its delay.
    • NewOscillate, for pistons, rockers and pumps. A to-and-fro on all three axes of shift and of turn at once, perfectly loopable. Waves: Sine, Piston (a crank turning a rod), Eased and Triangle, with lags that turn X and Y into circles and ellipses.
    • NewAnimation leaves the app. Include animation writes every moving part into a GLB or glTF as keyframes, and the timeline can be rendered to a WebM video. An Animation card in the right column plays, pauses, plays backwards and loops three ways.
    • NewAxis Center and the Axis card. Centre the axis of a part and reset its rotation, move the axis or the object to the origin, the selection or the view, align the axis to the world, its parent or the part’s faces, reset the scale. One undo step each, and the shape never moves.
    • NewClaude and notes. Seven new tools read, answer and leave notes (Claude writes under its own name and never signs a scene off), and four more lock parts, make copies unique, select instances and remove loose bits: 78 tools in all.
    • NewA selected group shows its parts softly. Ctrl+click or Shift+click lights up the ones you pick, and the group stays selected.
    • NewPython can come inside the Windows download. With the runtime folder beside the app, the first start has nothing to install.
    • NewShare to GrabCAD, Sketchfab, Printables, Thingiverse, Cults and MyMiniFactory from the Export window.
    • PolishThe Notes card has one toolbar and a menu, and recent cards show their notes. The search marks commands that open a panel and has shorter names. Claude mode says what each call did in words and shows no floor grid. Fewer pills. Dragging a command card is smooth.
    • PolishThe name in a serif: Fraunces Light for the name and the card titles, Source Serif 4 for the Serif choice. Both ship with the app.
    • FixThe installer works where Windows Script Host is switched off.
    • FixHeavy jobs no longer start on top of each other: Remove holes, Reduce, Split, Merge, Flatten, Fit and Smart optimise run one at a time.
    • FixA part that follows another is no longer sheared, stray edge lines after Remove holes are gone, and the Materials and Library docks no longer stack.
  2. v0.33.0Ptuj16 Oct 20263 fixes

    Notes are tasks. A title, a description, the parts, who it is for, a priority and a due date, with comments under them, and the notes leave the app as a spreadsheet, JSON or BCF.

    • NewA note is made with a form. Press N and click a spot, or right-click the model: Add a note here, Add a note to this part. A title, an optional description, the kind, who it is for, the priority, a due date and a screenshot. Comments go under the note afterwards.
    • NewEach kind has its own shape: a circle for Info, a rounded square for Question, a triangle for Issue, a diamond for Idea, with the number inside. A finished note is green, a late one has a red dashed outline, and a pin can show the title as a label on the model.
    • NewPriority and due dates. High and urgent notes are marked on the pin and in the list, a late note says Overdue, the list can be ordered by priority or due date, and opening a scene says how many notes are late.
    • NewA note can be about many parts, with no limit. The Parts section has a card for every part: Focus selects the part and takes the camera to it, and in edit mode a bin takes a part off and Add selected adds the parts selected in the viewport.
    • NewScreenshots, up to six, each with its own view. Clicking a picture flies back to the view it was taken from, and no picture is taken unless it is asked for.
    • NewComments have a thumb up, a thumb down and reply, and a reply shows what it answers. Typing @ offers the names on the notes, and a mention is highlighted.
    • NewEdit is in the three dots and turns them into a pencil: the title, description, kind, assignee, priority, due date and parts become fields, and the comments are out of the way until you press the pencil again.
    • NewSign-off on the scene. Approve or Changes in the card: one answer for everyone, shown with the names and saved with the scene.
    • NewThe note window opens on the right of the view, drags by its title bar, resizes by its edges, remembers where and how big, scrolls inside itself and has its shadow only while it is the window in use. Right-click a pin for comment, edit, resolve, kind, priority, due date, assign to me, move and delete.
    • NewThe Notes card is a task list: a tick marks a note done, with filters, search, order, only the notes on the selected part, arrows that go through the list and fly to each note, and a button that shows only the parts that have notes.
    • NewCSV, JSON and BCF. The export button writes a report page, a spreadsheet, JSON with every detail, or BCF 2.1 for design tools. Bring in notes reads a scene, a JSON file or a BCF file; a BCF file from another tool comes in without a pin and keeps its view.
    • FixSave writes over the scene’s file again after a restart. A scene saved by this app opens ready to be saved over, and Save with the same name replaces that file without asking where. A model from elsewhere is never offered for overwriting.
    • FixA big STEP file with colours on could stop the import with “step2glb.py exited with code 3221225477”. The app now tries again with the plain reader, so the model still opens, and the log says so.
    • FixThe notes window and card were rough: a pin slid away from the pointer on hover, the window jumped when clicked, the card would not fold, and the name box did not look like the rest of the app. All four are put right.
  3. v0.32.0Idrija15 Oct 2026

    Notes. Leave them on the model, answer, edit and resolve them, and send the scene with everything inside.

    • NewNotes on the model. Press N and click a spot: a numbered pin stays on that part, and follows it when the part moves, is hidden or the view is exploded. A small picture of the view is kept with the note. A note can also be about the selected part or the whole scene.
    • NewA conversation, not a label. Each note has a tag (Info, Question, Issue, Idea), can be given to somebody, and anyone can reply, edit or delete any message, resolve the note or open it again.
    • NewEvery change carries a name. You type your name once; every message shows who wrote it and when. An edit says who made it and keeps what it replaced, a deleted message says who deleted it and can come back, and each note has a history.
    • NewSaved with the scene. The notes go in the scene file, together with when each person last saved, so New to me shows what somebody else changed. Exports never contain notes, and other programs open the scene as an ordinary GLB.
    • NewThe Notes card lists them with filters (Open, All, Resolved, New to me, Mine, Deleted), search and sorting, and a click flies the camera back to the view the note was written from.
    • NewBring in the notes of another copy. When two people worked on their own copies of one scene, the notes are joined: new notes added, replies, edits and resolutions put together, and nothing anyone wrote is lost.
    • NewA report anyone can open. The notes as one HTML page with the pictures, every message, who edited what and the history. Copy puts them on the clipboard as text.
  4. v0.31.115 Oct 20268 fixes

    Enter goes into Edit mesh, Edit mesh and Undo work together, materials stay level everywhere, and the viewport no longer stalls.

    • NewEnter goes into Edit mesh with a part selected, in the mode you used last, and Enter again goes back out.
    • NewThe colour picker can be moved. Drag the strip along its top, or the hint along its bottom, to put it where it does not cover what you are colouring.
    • FixEdit mesh and Undo / Redo work together. What was picked is picked again after Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y of a move, and a delete taken back picks what it deleted.
    • FixThe viewport no longer stalls after editing. When the graphics card refuses a frame because a mesh has no normals, the app now repairs it and uploads the parts again by itself.
    • FixEvery place that shows a material says the same thing at once: the Materials list, the card in Properties, the inspector and the dots in the part tree. Drop a material on a part, assign it, undo it or change its colour, and they all follow.
    • FixThe colour dot in the part tree is the colour of the part’s material, not a copy kept on the part, so it can no longer show an old colour.
    • FixHeavy parts: the bars no longer grow again after every edit, and selecting a part in the view no longer ticks it in the list.
    • FixThe log console covers the toolbar at the bottom of the view instead of sitting under it.
    • FixThe buttons at the bottom of the Claude connection menu fit inside it. Claude mode has a row of its own and the other three sit under it.
    • PolishThe buttons in the top bar draw their icons at one size, so the sidebar button no longer looks heavier than Menu and Export.
    • PolishThe cards on the start screen show their shortcut when you point at them.
    • PolishSearch and filter boxes no longer pop up a tooltip. Their placeholder already says what they are.
  5. v0.31.0Bled15 Oct 20266 fixes

    A polish of the interface, and a tidier folder. Icons, menus and dropdowns share one look, groups can be locked, Export keeps the rest under Advanced and puts each part’s axis at the part, and the download is organised like an installed program.

    • NewA polish of the interface. The toolbar icons are sharper, their dividers easy to see, and the + and − of the part tree sit in the middle of their circles. Every menu and dropdown looks the same and opens the same way, and closes at once.
    • NewThe right-click menus of the part tree are about half as long. What you use least is one level in: Visibility, Select, Mesh, Fit and Tree for a part; Group, Order and Expand and collapse for a group.
    • NewPivot points in Export. A part from a STEP file has its origin at 0, 0, 0, so in Cinema 4D every axis sat there. GLB, glTF, FBX and USDZ now write each part around its own centre, so the axis is at the part. FBX objects carry the rotation and scale of their part too.
    • NewGroups can be locked. Lock in Properties, or “Lock everything inside” on the right-click menu of a group, locks every part in it. A locked part or group shows a red lock where its icon is.
    • NewThe Export window shows the format, the file name and “Visible parts only” up front. The rest is under Advanced, and it stays open or shut as you left it.
    • NewA tidier folder, and why. The top of the download had grown past fifty files, so it was hard to see what to double-click. It is organised like an installed program now: the launchers, the README and the licence, and one folder, app, with the program inside. The launchers keep their names, so shortcuts keep working.
    • NewMoving from an older version is one full download. The installer moves your inbox and exports into app, keeps the old loose files in a backup folder, and the first start builds the Python environment again.
    • PolishThe launcher window draws the name out of a wire mesh and shows a bar for each step.
    • PolishA tooltip no longer shows over a menu that is open, and the list beside a menu row stands next to it instead of over it.
    • FixExporting to FBX and opening it in Cinema 4D put every part’s axis at 0, 0, 0. It is now at the part.
    • FixRight-click menus no longer flicker when they close.
    • FixThe cards of the right panel sit on whole pixels, so their text and rows are no longer soft.
  6. v0.30.0Kobarid15 Oct 20269 fixes

    Two alpha features: Claude mode, to follow Claude as a feed with your model beside it, and Animate, to make parts spin, swing, shake and travel. Also instance commands, three-way permissions for Claude, a redesigned Settings and a rounder look.

    • NewClaude mode (alpha). Hide the app and follow Claude as a feed: what it says, every call it makes with what came back, and every picture it takes, with your model beside it as a rounded card you can show or hide. Open it from the start screen, the Claude badge, the command search, or with ?claude on the address. It is an early version, so expect rough edges.
    • NewThe first card of a Claude session is your model. It shows the picture, the name, type and size, the parts, triangles and vertices, how long it took to open, and a green “Ready for Claude”. The numbers roll up as it lands, and the model fades in.
    • NewOpen a model in Claude mode. The folder button opens “Open file…” and your recent files, with a picture, size and age each, and the latest marked Continue. You can drop a file on the feed. A model opens in the same view and replaces the one that is open, with no scene tab laid over it.
    • NewLoading you can follow. A card floats above the controls with what the app is doing, the step, the percent, the time and a Cancel button. Nothing in the feed moves when it appears.
    • NewControls in the feed. Three buttons copy the command of a ready-made job (Optimise for web, Remove fasteners, Review scene), switches for Connected and Ask before edits, Undo and Redo, a button that copies the connection command, and a Stop button while a long job runs. Exit asks first.
    • NewClaude can write to the feed. A new tool, say, puts a short message in front of you: what it is about to do and what it found. Claude now has 67 tools.
    • NewAnimate (alpha). A new window makes a part or a group spin, swing, shake (noise) or travel along a path: circle, figure of eight, rounded square, wave or line. Each has its own controls, spin and path loop with loop points on a small timeline, and a part can carry one layer of each kind, added together. A playbar plays, pauses, rewinds and scrubs one cycle at 0.25× to 4×. A pill in the view says Animate mode, Playing or Paused.
    • NewAnimations are a view, not an edit. They keep running when the window closes, saving a scene or exporting puts every part back first, and the turntable video plays them, each frame at its own time. Open Animate from a right-click on a part, a group or the view, or with Ctrl+K.
    • NewClaude can say what moves. The new animate_parts tool adds, removes, lists or clears animations by part, name or group.
    • NewSelect all instances, Select the original and Make unique. Pick every part that shares the exact same geometry, jump to the first of them, or give the selected shared parts a mesh of their own so editing one leaves the copies alone (one undo step). They are in the command search, the “…” menu, and the right-click menus of the tree and the view.
    • NewClaude’s permissions are three choices per kind of change: Allow, Ask first or Block, as a small icon switch in Settings › Claude. The old switches keep working until you choose.
    • NewThe start screen shows a Scania V8 engine, 1,295 parts, in line drawing, and there is a tool to bake one from any GLB (tools/build-splash-glb.mjs).
    • PolishClaude’s quick colour wheel opens with the part’s colour under the pointer. Move to choose and click the ring to keep it. Letting go of C, Esc or a click outside puts the old colour back.
    • PolishSettings looks like a settings window should: wider, with the search at the top of the section list, no header and footer bars, bigger rows with a quiet line of help, and group titles in plain type.
    • PolishAdvanced flatten shows each choice as a small before and after tree, with a legend, whole cards you can click and shorter help. It is at the top of the Flatten menu, and “Selected groups only” follows the selection while the window is open.
    • PolishBatch rename, Advanced flatten, Animate, Materials and Library share one title bar. Windows and the tree and menus open, close and drag more smoothly.
    • PolishRounder corners by default. Appearance › Corners is now Sharp or Default, and a saved Round is Default.
    • PolishThe Export window lists the formats by name, and the Export button floats at the bottom right and folds into a round button while you scroll the options.
    • PolishThe keyboard shortcuts window is in colour: an icon on each command, a colour for each group, and the keys of the on-screen keyboard tinted by category. It follows the colour switch for search results.
    • PolishThe start screen puts New scene first. A converted file is a badge on its card. The quit dialog has a warning, keeps Don’t save apart from Cancel and Save, and focuses Save.
    • PolishThe seven tree toolbar buttons share the row, the button of an open menu stays lit, and a second press closes its menu. The command-panel buttons turn blue while their card is open. Scrubbing a number shows a visible fill. One tick mark is used everywhere.
    • PolishThe File menu no longer lists Scene settings and Help & docs. Both are in the command search, Ctrl+; and F1 still open them, and the start screen has Help.
    • PolishThe view toggles in the Library and Materials windows have a sliding thumb, and the selected button is clearly lighter. Toolbars over the view sit on whole device pixels.
    • FixA STEP made of faceted breps (a mesh exported from 3ds Max or CAD Exchanger) failed with “no solid bodies found in this STEP” after ten minutes. The plain reader now meshes the closed shells, so it opens: the 413 MB Mercedes-Benz Arocs, with 645,108 bodies.
    • FixUndo and redo on an exploded view left the parts, the sliders and the pill out of step, and holding Ctrl+Z froze the page. They now put an exploded view back together first, and a held Ctrl+Z or Ctrl+Y does one step per press.
    • FixExploding, deleting a part, putting the view back and undoing the delete brought the part back exploded, with the amount at zero. A deleted part now moves with the exploded view.
    • FixThe × count and the “original” mark on instances were wrong after Make unique or deleting copies. The count is live now, and the first of its kind keeps the part icon.
    • FixDragging a material ball showed the system’s copy arrow, which could not be hidden. The ball itself follows the pointer now, and drops on the view, on the Properties material card, or with Shift on another material to merge.
    • FixDelete and Backspace deleted parts in the view while I was working in the Materials window. They delete the picked materials there now.
    • FixThe Model mode button, and keys 1, 2 and 3, did nothing useful with nothing selected. The button is greyed and the keys say “Select a part first.” Edit mesh is off while the Animate window is open.
    • FixThe grid lines in the view were two or three pixels of mush from far away. They are one crisp pixel now, axis lines included.
    • FixOpening Advanced flatten decided “Selected groups only” once. It now follows what is selected.
    • PerfDragging and resizing a floating window, the Materials and Library docks and the console happens once per frame, and the sizes are saved once, when you let go.
    • PerfBackground checks pause while the tab is hidden, and the thumbnails in the Materials list are drawn as they scroll into view.
    • PerfBackdrop blur is gone from the dialogs, pills, the gizmo HUD and tooltips, which makes drawing lighter. Batch rename draws the first 300 rows of its preview and says how many more it renames by the same rule.
  7. v0.29.0Bohinj14 Oct 20269 fixes

    • NewAlign and Spread work on groups. A selected group is lined up as one item, measured by the box round all its parts, so its parts keep their places against each other. Mix groups and loose parts if you like; a group with a locked part stays where it is.

    • PolishSelect is the blue tool in the tool strip and the gizmo tools are grey when on. Dynamic place sits beside Measure and Draw lines, and the Shading angle has moved into the Shading card.
    • PolishA tighter quick colour wheel. It clears the view while it is open, draws back in when it closes, and no longer scans every part on every frame.
    • PolishSharp to the pixel. Edges and lines sit on whole device pixels, icon lines are one pixel thick, and a press dims a button instead of shrinking it, so nothing goes soft while you click.

  8. v0.28.0Postojna14 Oct 202613 fixes

    MeshOptimiser now tells you what is wrong inside a model, and helps you fix it. Faces that point the wrong way, holes, needle triangles, a texture laid out badly: found, shown and one tap from fixed. Your CAD file keeps its true edges. And it installs with a double-click.

    • NewModel inspector. One window shows what the model is and what is broken in it: inside-out parts, faces turned the wrong way, holes and cracks, doubled and needle triangles. Every problem has a button to select it and a button that opens the tool that fixes it.
    • NewFix normals. Find the faces that point the wrong way, turn them round or line them up with their neighbours, and paint the wrong side red while you look. One undo takes it back.
    • NewUV layout. See how a texture sits on a part: the islands, what covers the same place twice, what lies outside the square, with the numbers beside it.
    • NewThe true faces and edges of a STEP file. A CAD edges pill appears when you open one. Point at a face and it is named and tinted; hide the tangent edges of fillets when they are in the way. Sheet covers and other surface-only parts come along too.
    • NewQuick colour wheel. Hold C over the model, move, let go. The angle is the hue, the distance is the saturation, the scroll wheel is the brightness. Drag far out to cancel.
    • NewA colour picker built for modelling: a square or a wheel, HEX, RGB, HSV and HSL, a pipette, and Ctrl+Z that steps back through the colours you picked. Materials are edited right where you see them.
    • NewOne View button for Solid, Wireframe, X-ray and Heatmap, quick choices on Collapse, Rename and Flatten, four more lists in the Commands menu, and a tidier Quick wand.
    • NewA one-click installer for Windows. It finds the newest version, downloads it with a progress bar, adds MeshOptimiser to your Desktop and Start menu, and gets Chrome if you do not have it. Settings › General can show or hide the terminal window.
    • PolishProperties and Shading sit edge to edge, Reduce shows what it will do as a figure, and the Edit mesh tool bar slides in and out.
    • FixUndo now reaches colours and sliders in the material editor and the light, exposure, field of view and fog sliders, and shortcuts work while a slider has the focus.
    • FixThe colour picker keeps its Was and New strip while you drag, its corners are clean, and Ctrl+Z no longer closes it.
    • FixSwitching Shadows on and off quickly no longer loses the view, and closing with a model open asks first.
    • FixAlign and Repair mesh turn pieces with gaps outward, a part inverted all over included, and points in Edit mesh no longer show through thin parts.

  13. v0.24.0Soča12 Oct 20264 fixes

    Into the mesh. Pick points, edges and polygons and move, weld, fill or dissolve them. The shortcuts window is a keyboard now, and every key is yours to change.

    • NewEdit mesh. Points, Edges, Polygons and Model, as in Cinema 4D. Keys 1, 2, 3 and 4 switch between them, and the selected parts show their polygons, not their triangles.

A file name with the same pills as Save scene, a summary of what will be written, Flatten groups, ASCII STL, only the options that apply to the format, and your choices remembered. Batch rename is redesigned too, with a Quick tab, buttons for the pattern pieces and a preview that marks what changed.
    • PolishCards over the viewport can be moved by their title bar. Stacked copies is one of them now. Heavy parts are the parts over 10,000 triangles, with a count beside the title. The sidebars have drag handles that stay put and a minimum width, and the Collapse button has a menu for the whole tree, the selection or from the selection down.
    • PolishFaster on a big model. The outline of the selection and the edge lines are drawn by the graphics card, so nothing is copied when parts move, and the picture for the Recents list and the spare copy of the app for the next tab wait until you have stopped clicking.
    • FixEdge lines show on every part whatever the tilt, are not hidden by the ground grid, and no longer trail behind their parts in an exploded view. Materials work while Clay or CAD is on, and the Properties card shows the material the part really has.
    • NewSmart optimise. One card, one button, at the top of Reduce. It runs every clean-up the app has, one after another: empty and broken parts, parts hidden inside, bolts and nuts, small parts, holes in flat faces, and a reduction to the triangle count you set. Light, Balanced or Strong, or Auto. The whole run is one undo step.
    • NewFasteners finds bolts, screws, nuts and washers by their shape, whatever they’re called, and selects them. Stacked copies finds parts drawn twice in the same place. Select similar has a strictness slider, from “about the same size” to “the very same shape”.
    • NewThe library is a drawer under the viewport (Shift + L). Click a part to look at it, turn it, set its size, and then it goes in with those sizes. A starred shelf, small or large tiles.
    • NewDrop a file on a scene that already has parts and the app asks: add it here, or open it in a new tab. Right-click a tab for duplicate, close others and recent files. Hold Shift while dragging a handle to snap, and turn the wheel to change the step.
    • FixCinema 4D opens the FBX. A binary FBX carries an id, a creation time and a closing code that have to agree, and the FBX SDK refuses the file when they don’t. Mine wrote a random id with a fixed code, so Blender and the app could read it and Cinema 4D couldn’t. They agree now.
    • FixAn FBX now says what its units are and which way is up. A 2.6 m machine used to arrive in Cinema 4D 26 m long, and a Z-up scene was labelled Y-up.
    • FixThe binary FBX shares its materials: one per colour instead of one per mesh. A 778-part model arrived with 778 materials and took 13 seconds to open. Now it has 40 and opens in 1.4 s. OBJ keeps parts that share a name separate: 778 parts used to arrive as 325.
    • FixUp axis and Scene scale no longer leak into the file for some parts and not others. A part you moved after changing either one used to be written turned or resized while its neighbours weren’t.
    • FixThe local server only answers the app’s own page. Before, any web page open in your browser could send requests to localhost:4242. Folders are no longer listed either, and nothing is served from .git or .venv.
    • FixNames and scene data from a file are never run as markup. Three places built HTML from them without escaping: measurements saved inside a GLB, the label that follows a dragged tree row, and the Flatten dialog.
    • FixA fresh install converts STEP again. The OpenCascade package had moved to a version the converter can’t import, so the versions are pinned now, and start.bat installs again when the requirements change or the first install failed.
    • FixPosition, rotation and size show the whole number. The steppers took half the field and the unit sat on top of the digits, so −1091.234 read as −1091.
    • FixHidden instanced parts no longer wreck Select all. A hidden copy was built from a zero matrix, and the NaN that came out spread to every selected part. Undo now brings back deleted instanced parts, which used to come back as rows with nothing drawn.
    • FixUndoing a fit in an exploded view no longer throws parts around, and merging in an exploded view no longer leaves the merged part at the exploded place. Merge now keeps the part where it was in the tree, in the same group and at the same depth.
    • FixSmart fit no longer fits and moves its neighbours. Parts that shared a shape with a fitted part were fitted with it, and put on its position, if they stood within 5% of the model’s size.
    • FixThe Heavy parts list follows the scene. A part deleted with the Delete key stayed listed, and undo didn’t bring it back.
    • FixA hidden part kept its selection outline, and a part shown again had none. Every way of hiding and showing now ends with the outline on exactly the selected parts you can see.
    • FixDelete small parts only looks at parts that are on show, and tells you how many hidden ones it skipped.
    • FixLess flicker between panels lying on each other. The camera’s near plane now follows the model’s nearest depth, which gives the depth buffer several times the precision at normal distances: 0.001 mm instead of 0.008 mm on a 3.5 m assembly seen from 6.8 m.
    • FixThe 2D views (Top, Front, Side) have their grid back, orbiting out of one returns to the perspective camera, and screenshots from them aren’t stretched.
    • FixFiles with invalid coordinates open. NaN and Infinity become 0, with a notice, where before the camera turned into not-a-number and the viewport never recovered. Broken and empty files get a plain message.
    • FixFBX files with leftover geometry open directly instead of going through the slower conversion. A geometry attached to nothing, left behind when its object was deleted before export, made the reader give up.
    • FixSplit by proximity can’t freeze the tab on a plate or a box any more. Its grid is bounded now, where one triangle used to fill millions of cells.
    • FixA colour changed in the material editor is exported and shows on the part’s swatch. Duplicate and Split keep the material a part is wearing. Clay no longer sticks to parts made while it was on.
    • FixQuit asks about every open scene, not only the one in front. Import no longer turns later Opens into appends, and “Don’t ask again” can be undone in Settings.
    • FixSettings and Keyboard shortcuts open in front of the start screen. They used to open behind it, so nothing seemed to happen.
    • FixSwitches can be reached with Tab and flipped with Space. Enter presses the button that has focus in a dialog instead of always accepting, and Esc in a dropdown closes only the dropdown. Single-key shortcuts no longer fire behind a dialog.
    • FixA STEP file with nothing solid in it says so instead of showing a traceback. Cancelling a conversion stops the converter on macOS and Linux too, and a cancel that arrives early isn’t lost.
    • FixThe launchers check for Python 3.10 to 3.12 and say what’s wrong when it’s another version. Starting the app twice opens the window on the server that’s already running. The macOS launchers are executable after a clone.
    • FixDozens of smaller ones: Lock on a mixed selection, Find and Replace treating $ as text, OBJ export keeping non-Latin names, ASCII FBX keeping its precision at any scale, the cloner leaving a copy at the centre, redo in the cloner throwing the rest of the redo list away, and more. The full list is on GitHub.

    • FixDragging a number could go on following the mouse after you let go, and a click didn’t always put the caret in the field. Tooltips inside a card appeared instantly and cut off after the first words; they wait now and show the whole tip.
    • PolishA darker, calmer interface in one tone. The GPU path tracer is gone, and nothing is fetched from a CDN at start-up.
  23. v0.10Kit7 Oct 202617 fixes

    Faster, with tools it didn’t have before: a hole filler that can tell a hole from a boss, a materials drawer, a decimator that keeps normals and UVs, background workers, and a part tree that keeps up with five million triangles. And a long list of things that were quietly wrong in the tree. Version 0.10.1 followed ten minutes later with one change: the libraries the viewer needs now come with the app, so it starts without a CDN and works with no connection at all.

    • FixThe tree hides nothing. A group used to vanish from the hierarchy as soon as it had no live parts, although it still existed. Every group is listed now, and one with nothing in it says “empty”.
    • FixDeleting a group deletes the group. Delete on a selected group, and “Delete group” in the menu, remove the row with its contents, and one undo brings both back.
    • FixThe parts tree scrolls in one direction, with the eye and colour column staying lined up. Rows used to be as wide as their own text, so the eyes of short rows slid around when you scrolled sideways.
    • FixImport and Append keep the existing tree instead of moving every part into “Untraced”. A failed load no longer turns the next Open into an append.
    • FixA second geometry edit on the same part could stop the viewport from drawing at all, with an error on every frame. The WebGPU renderer decides what to upload by comparing attribute names and version numbers, and a freshly built geometry looked unchanged to it. Every tool that swaps geometry now stamps it.
    • FixEvery remaining editing gap now has an undo: values typed into the transform panel, tree drag and drop, the eye icon on a group, every other visibility toggle, and the materials panel.
    • FixHiding and showing reach instanced parts everywhere: the eye icon, Hide unselected, group toggles and hide by colour.
    • FixCloner copies are exported and saved. Only the source part used to be written.
    • FixCancel stops a STEP conversion. The loader’s Cancel ends the polling and stops the converter on the server, so a conversion can’t finish later and replace your scene.
    • FixThe move readout showed “Y +0.00” and “Z +0.00” while you dragged a rotated part, because it read the travel along the wrong axes. It follows the gizmo’s own axes now.
    • FixIn a small window the right sidebar was pushed off the edge. The column shrinks now, and the status bar drops the vertex and memory counts, then the file name, before anything else.
    • FixCollapsing and re-expanding a group no longer brings back the rows of deleted parts, and adding a shape highlights the new part in the tree instead of the previous one.
    • FixThe icon set is pinned to one version (0.10.1). It used to load as “latest”, so an upstream release could rename or drop an icon without warning.
  24. v0.9.0Mir7 Oct 202624 fixes

    More trustworthy. A self-test that runs inside the app, undo for every action, exports that match the scene, and a restyled interface. This was the version where I stopped trusting that things worked and started checking.

    • NewA self-test that runs inside the app and checks the things that broke before.
    • FixDecimate destroyed parts. The removal count was taken from the un-indexed corner count, three per triangle, instead of the welded vertex count, so at −50% most parts were reduced to zero triangles. Now −25, −50 and −75% remove exactly that share.
    • FixDecimate never reached the export. The reduced geometry wasn’t registered under the part’s hash, so export, merge and the memory readout still used the original mesh.
    • FixSave scene lost its state. The marker node was flagged invisible and the exporter skips invisible objects, so the camera, view settings, hidden parts and measurements were never written. Save scene also mangled node names and wrapped the scene in one more group on every save and reopen.
    • FixExporting in Wireframe, X-ray or Heatmap baked the view mode into the file. Export and Save scene now run in Solid and put the view back afterwards.
    • FixRecenter and Center pivot didn’t reach the export, so the file kept the old positions. Bake transforms also displaced parts that sat under a moved parent, and a part that shared its buffer with another (any duplicate) was transformed twice or moved a part you hadn’t selected.
    • FixPLY export hung on “Preparing export…” whenever the tab was in the background. Hidden instanced parts exported with NaN transforms.
    • FixSix tools pushed no undo entry, so Ctrl+Z reverted an older, unrelated action: Decimate, Recenter on origin, Bake transforms, Center pivot, Recompute normals and Delete empty groups. All six undo and redo now. Undo of Isolate, Show all and Hide unselected restores instanced parts as well.
    • FixFlatten and “Delete empty groups” work from the tree now. Selecting a part moves its mesh out of its group in the scene graph, and both tools trusted the scene graph. Grouping parts from different levels no longer pulls the outside part into the first part’s group.
    • FixDelete acted on the scene behind an open dialog, and Ctrl+S also toggled Isolate. Global shortcuts are ignored while a dialog is open or a dropdown has focus.
    • FixThe ruler only measured on Ctrl+click while the hint said “Click two points”. A plain click picks now, and picking no longer changes the selection.
    • FixShift-click range no longer sweeps up rows hidden by a search or a collapsed group. “% of model” showed 173% for a single cube. Three sidebar cards wouldn’t collapse. A few shortcut hints were wrong.
  25. v0.8.0Dim11 May 20269 fixes

    The groundwork got modern: a ray-marched floor grid, one keycap style on every shortcut, undo rebuilt as a flat list of commands, and all the CSS that was injected at runtime moved into the stylesheet.

    • NewA ray-marched ground grid. It stays sharp at any distance, doesn’t shimmer when you orbit, and doesn’t fight with the model for depth.
    • NewA new Shortcuts overlay with a sticky search, category headers, two columns and one keycap per key of a combination. Press ? to open it.
    • PolishOne keycap style on the hint strip, the tooltips, the command palette, the brand menu and the Shortcuts overlay. Smart fit and its arrow are one control now.
    • RefactorEight pieces of CSS that were injected at runtime (about 490 lines) moved into the stylesheet, and eleven undo patches became one registry covering 21 operations.
    • FixThe grid shimmered by a pixel or two when you orbited, because the camera-follow moved the mesh by sub-pixel amounts every frame. The cube on the grid no longer fights it for depth.
    • FixThe tree summary stayed at “1 parts in hierarchy” after a delete because it counted deleted parts too. A group’s origin dot no longer gets stranded in space when every part in it is deleted.
    • FixThe group button no longer asks for a name, and the path tracer no longer throws an error into the console on an empty scene.
    • FixThree bugs in the materials panel: adding a material toasted a confusing hint, duplicating one needed a part selected for no reason, and merging left the absorbed materials in the list as ghosts and leaked their GPU memory.
  26. v0.7.0Slap11 May 2026

    A GPU path tracer with a render window that builds up samples, a hint strip that follows what you’re doing, an add-a-shape picker on long press, a standalone Cloner you can drag parts into, and Revert to source.

  27. v0.6.0Sir11 May 20263 fixes

    A live Cloner, a Ctrl-click measure tool, an origin marker for every group, a two-panel Export window, simplification and Meshopt on by default, and mouse buttons that work the way CAD programs expect.

    • FixFace winding. Only truly reversed faces are flipped now. The old check also flipped internal and external faces and left back-face artefacts on cellular geometry.
    • FixTwo different shapes could end up with the same hash, so a cube and its diagonal mirror were treated as one. They aren’t any more.
    • FixThe size readout of a Meshopt-compressed GLB was blind, because the library that read it can’t decode compressed files. It reads the file’s own header now.
  28. v0.5.0Vas8 May 20261 fix

    Scene management (New scene, Import and merge, Scene settings), parametric shapes with millimetre inputs, transforms that know their units, backgrounds without banding, and a clean shutdown.

    • FixThe Transform panel refreshes after a shape is rebuilt, so the numbers match the new geometry instead of staying on the old ones.
  29. v0.4.0Rob7 May 20264 fixes

    HDRI lighting, an endless floor grid with fog, parametric shapes, a camera pill with Ctrl or ⌘ + 1 to 4, popups without borders, and a refreshed blue.

    • FixThe right-click menu in the viewport was completely broken: another handler cancelled every right-click before the app’s menu could build. It works again.
    • FixGoing back to an HDRI background after loading another one gave a black scene. A rapid edit of a shape’s parameters could crash the renderer on a buffer race.
    • FixTooltips no longer get stranded on screen when a popup opens, a dialog shows, the window loses focus, or a panel slides in over the button.
  30. v0.3.0Log7 May 20265 fixes

    A full material editor with shader-ball previews, a scale gizmo that snaps with Shift and shows live values, screenshots at any size, Top, Front and Side views, and a rescue path for old FBX files.

    • FixSaving a screenshot fired the save dialog twice and wrote a 0-byte PNG. A save that was refused, or locked by OneDrive, silently dropped the file; all three failures now fall back to a normal download.
    • FixTextures leaked memory every time you swapped models. They’re all released now, and material thumbnails fall back to a simple 2D drawing when WebGL isn’t there, instead of blank tiles.
    • FixCopy, Paste and Select All work again on every number and text field. A custom right-click had been eating them everywhere.
  31. v0.2.0Dom6 May 2026

    The editing side arrived: a start screen, a command palette, a shortcuts overlay, settings, section planes, a switchable renderer, batch rename, flatten, dissolve and ungroup, undo and redo, and Save scene. Expanding and collapsing a tree of 10,000 nodes went from about a second to under 10 ms.

  32. v0.1.0Pot5 May 2026

    The first public commit: the STEP to GLB pipeline, the WebGPU viewer with the part tree, picking, hide, isolate and colouring by group, the local server, one-click launchers, and bundled Draco and Assimp decoders.
